blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — With the House prosecution panel expected to wrap up its presentation by Tuesday, Vice President Sara Duterte’s defense team is scheduled to begin presenting its case on Nov. 9, Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian said Monday. “Their schedule is Nov. 9, when we return. There will be an impeachment session in the morning, then we’ll open the session at 3 p.m.,” Gatchalian told reporters. The prosecution earlier manifested its intention to dispense with presenting evidence for Article III of the impeachment complaint, which accuses Duterte of bribing Department of Education officials.
